title: Fabrication of inorganic@organic V2O5@PEDOT nanocomposite cathode for advanced aqueous manganese-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22690-22698
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03230J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xianyu Liu, Jianan Zhao, Zhigang Fan, Yingchun Xiao, Yande Zhao, Qing Guo
Inorganic@organic V2O5@PEDOT nanocomposite is synthesized via a facile in situ polymerization method by combining the EDOT monomer with V2O5, delivering excellent electrochemical performance for manganese-ion batteries.
